title: Nighttime Sizzling Velvet Turkish Lardons Kunefe
description: A rich and savory Turkish dessert that combines crispy phyllo, creamy vegan butter, and caramelized lardons. Serve warm, straight from the iron teppan.
instructions: Heat the iron teppan to 400°F (200°C) for 30 minutes before use.
Layer 1/3 of the phyllo dough on the preheated teppan, brushing with vegan butter.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo dough, brushing each layer with vegan butter.
Heat the lardons in a separate pan over medium heat until caramelized, about 20 minutes.
Transfer the caramelized lardons to a bowl with the sugar, and mix until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the sugar-lardon mixture over the phyllo layers on the teppan, spreading evenly.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the phyllo is golden brown and the lardons are crispy.
Remove from heat, let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm, straight from the teppan, garnished with rose water and pistachios if desired.
